hypothesis: Instruction count is primarily explained by output batch size, active proposal count, total searched tokens, and a potentially large first-call compilation cost.

pcvs.name: request_count
pcvs.rationale: Tracks output-list construction, including the large empty initialization batch.

pcvs.name: ngram_request_count
pcvs.rationale: Tracks per-request Numba dispatch, proposal handling, and output conversion.

pcvs.name: searched_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Tracks the aggregate sequence length scanned by the n-gram search.

pcvs.name: requires_numba_compilation
pcvs.rationale: Identifies the first nonempty call, which triggers lazy Numba compilation inside the region.
